events.content: John: Hey! Glad to finally talk to you. I want to ask you, what motivates you?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Hey John! Video games give me tons of joy and excitement, so they keep me motivated!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Cool, James! I'm a big video game fan too. They help me relax after a long day. What game are you currently enjoying the most?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: I'm totally into The Witcher 3 right now. The story and atmosphere are amazing. Have you tried it yet?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Haven't played it yet, but I hear it's awesome. Gonna give it a go. BTW, just signed up for a programming class. Have you ever done any programming?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Programming is an awesome skill. I tried it out one in college and now it`s all my life. Good luck in the class! Do you have any coding experience?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: I did a bit of coding in HTML and CSS a few years back. Thought I'd refresh those skills in this course. What languages do you like most and any projects you've done?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a computer screen showing a video game scene] I've worked with Python and C++. I've built a website and also created some game mods. Here is one example.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: That mod looks amazing! The graphics are awesome. What other programming languages have you worked with?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: I haven’t worked with any other programming languages, but I hope to work in the future.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Maybe in the future we will develop mobile applications together? Do you like the idea?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of two dogs are tied to a fence with a leash] It would be cool! For example, we could write some kind of application for dogs. By the way, my dogs.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Aww, they're adorable! What are the names of your pets? And what are your plans for the app?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Max and Daisy. Will be actually cool to build an app for dog walking and pet care. The goal is to connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and provide helpful information on pet care.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Sounds good, James! Bet that app would find a lot of buyers. What sets it apart from other existing apps?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a notepad with a handwritten note on it] Thanks, John! The personal touch really sets it apart. Users can add their pup's preferences/needs - just like they were customizing it for them. Making it unique for each owner and pup.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: That's a great idea! Your pup is gonna love it. Speaking of personal touches, what motivates you to work on your programming projects?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a person holding a notebook with a list of things on it] Creating something and seeing it come to life gives me a great sense of accomplishment. It's an amazing feeling. I write down all my goals in a notebook. It's very satisfying to check off each one when it's done.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: What are you working on that has you feeling so accomplished?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a drawing of a girl in a plane] I'm working on something I've wanted to do since I was a kid. Even as a child, I made some sketches of the main character. Back then I was just drawing comics, but now I want to turn it into a computer game. It's a project that has me really excited.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Wow, James! That's amazing. What made you decide to work on it and create your own game?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: I'm always excited to combine my favorite passions: gaming and storytelling. It's great creating my own project and bringing my ideas to life, plus the challenge is really enjoyable!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: [Image: a photo of a medical chart with instructions for the procedure] That sounds really fulfilling! Combining your passions to make something new must be so exciting. Can't wait to see the outcome.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Thanks John! It's super exciting. I'll keep you updated on the progress. Perhaps, thanks to your knowledge of HTML, I'll invite you to help with some things in my game.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: It will be great to work with you, James.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: I'll be looking forward to it. By the way, yesterday I went bowling and got 2 strikes. I love bowling!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: I'm sure you're very good at this. Unfortunately, I can’t share my love for him with you, my fingers are too big. Perhaps I should take up exercise, at least start going for a run in the morning. And I also don’t like bowling itself, to be honest.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: It's a pity, it would be nice to go play with you one day.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Well, I'm sure we can do something else. We can play slot machines and arcades, for example.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: The last time I played at the slot machines, I was so engrossed in the game that I didn't notice my wallet being taken out of my pocket. Sad story.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: I'm sorry to hear it. Well, I'll be nearby, I'll look after your pockets.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Still, maybe we can try something different?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Heard about VR gaming? It's pretty immersive. We can try it together!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: I tried it - it's crazy how real it feels! Have you given it a shot?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Tried it a few times, it's insane how immersive that experience can be. Can't wait to try it together with you.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Yeah, VR gaming is awesome! Let`s do it next Saturday!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Agreed, James!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Hey John, something awesome happened since we talked. I made a game avatar and joined a new platform. It's so fun exploring and chatting with other gamers - it's a whole new adventure every time! I feel like I'm part of a super cool online community.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Hey James, awesome! Glad you're enjoying it and connecting with others. Building a community is really cool, especially when you meet people who enjoy the same things.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Thanks, John! Connecting with other gamers has been great! We've shared tips, strategies, and stories about gaming. It's amazing how it brings people together, regardless of their backgrounds.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: That's incredible! It's so cool how gaming can bring people together and create a strong bond, regardless of their background.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Yeah, it's our shared language and passion. It's been a refuge for me in tough times.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Yeah, gaming always helps me escape stress. It's amazing how it calms me down during tough times.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Games are my go-to when I'm feeling overwhelmed. It's like therapy. I can relax, forget my troubles, and get lost in another world.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Gotcha. Gaming can be a great way to take a break and escape for a while. Anything new you've been into lately?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Lately, I've been checking out different styles of it. It's been fun to try something fresh and test myself in other ways. What about you, John? Any new hobbies recently?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: I've been getting into a new hobby recently. I bought a metal detector and walk along the beaches looking for something worthwhile.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Interesting, John! Sounds like an awesome immersive experience. Already found something interesting?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Mostly just bottle caps, but a couple of times I found coins, and once even a gold ring.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Cool, I wish you good luck in this matter! By the way, I've got something to show you.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Show me what you've got! What is it?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth] Check out this pic of my best buds having a blast in the park. They've brought so much joy to my life. My two dogs are the best pals ever, right?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: They look like they're having a blast! Can they do any tricks?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a dog laying on a bed with a name tag] They can do tricks like sit, stay, paw, and rollover. Here's a picture of Daisy waiting for a treat. I've done lots of training and they've picked it up fast. They're like my family.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Aww, they're adorable! Pets are the best - they must make life so much better. I want one so bad, but I'm not there yet. Someday!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: A pet would truly be great for you! They bring so much love and companionship. If you're interested, I can help find the perfect one for you - you'd make a great pet parent!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Cheers, James! Yeah, I'll keep that in mind. Appreciate the offer.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: No problem, John! Let me know whenever you need assistance. Take care!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Hey James, long time no see! I had a big win in my game last week - finally advanced to the next level! It was a huge confidence booster and felt like I'd really achieved something.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photography of a drum kit with a white drum and a black drum] Hey John, congrats on your win! Games can really boost confidence, huh? I'm challenging myself too - I'm learning this instrument, which has been quite the journey.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: [Image: a photo of a drum kit sitting on top of a table] Thanks, James! I play drums too! Here's a pic of my set.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Wow, looking good! How long have you been playing?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: I've been playing for a month now, it's been tough but fun. How about you, how's it going?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: This is going great! I started a few days ago, so I'm still picking it up. Been at it daily and seeing improvements. It's tough but rewarding at the same time!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Nice work! Looks like you're doing great. Anything new in general that you'd recommend?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Thanks! I just got a new cutting-edge gaming system and the graphics are incredible. I've been playing all kinds of new games and it's been a great way to relax after work. Plus, I can connect with friends who share my passion for gaming.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: [Image: a photography of a crowded convention hall with a large crowd of people] Cool, James! Gaming is great for chilling out. Btw, since we last spoke, I had the chance to go to a gaming convention - it was amazing! Tried out loads of games, met developers, and even took part in a tournament - unreal! Check out this pic I took!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Wow, that's awesome! What game was it for? Sounds like a dream!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: I played my favorite CS:GO game in an intense tournament. It was awesome to see all the skilled players competing.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Wow, that sounds cool! Gaming is awesome with all the competition. Must have been thrilling to watch those skilled players!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: It was indeed amazing! Watching those skilled players really inspired me to improve my own gaming skills.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Nice one, John! Learning from experienced gamers can really help you level up your skills. Keep it up!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: I'm always looking to up my game and hit new goals. That same commitment is true for my hobbies and other stuff. What have you been doing to stay motivated?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Setting small goals and tracking my progress helps me stay motivated and focused.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Nice one! Setting small goals and tracking progress is a great way to stay motivated - it helps you stay on track and celebrates progress. Anything specific you're working on or upcoming challenges you're pumped about?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: I'm getting into different types of games now, like RPGs and strategy games. It's really exciting!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Cool, James! That sounds exciting. Have fun exploring different genres of games!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: I'm super hyped to explore different game genres. Let's see what's in store!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Definitely! Trying new genres is always exciting. I can't wait to hear about your journey with them. Please let me know how it goes!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Got it, John! I'll keep you updated on my gaming adventures with the new genres. Have a good day!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Thanks! Can't wait to hear about it. Bye!
events.speaker: John

events.content: John: Hey James! Long time no chat. What's up? Been playing any new games lately?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a group of people posing for a picture] Hey John! Yeah, it's been a while. I've been busy, but I joined an online gaming tournament yesterday. It was so intense and fun! Here is a photo report.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: That online gaming tournament looks awesome! Glad you had a blast. How did it go for you?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a man in a costume standing in front of a sign] It was so much fun! I did pretty well in the tournament; I made it to the semis and won some rounds. It was such a rush! Here's a screenshot of my character.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Wow, awesome! Congrats on your performance and making it to the semifinals. How did the final rounds turn out?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a man in a costume holding a sword] Thanks John! The final rounds were tough. I tried my best but didn't make it. It was close, though, and I had a blast competing with talented players. Looking forward to the next tournament!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Met any famous player there?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a man sitting in a chair playing a video game] I met the whole team! It’s a pity I didn’t get a chance to take a photo with them, but one of them even gave me a couple of gaming tips.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Cool! I'm sure his advice will help you develop in the game.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a notepad with a pen and a glass of water] Yes, I'm sure of that too. Also, the whole team gave me autographs. I was very happy about this!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: How cool is this! What advice do you remember most?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a group of people standing around a table] The most important thing I remember is that you always need to communicate correctly with the team and never put your ego above team success.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Yeah, comms and teamwork are super important in gaming. When everyone works together, it's incredible what can be accomplished in a match. How do you usually communicate with your team?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: I usually use voice chat to communicate with my team. It's fast and helps us work together effectively.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Sounds like a good plan. It really helps with communication. What game do you like playing with your team?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a video game screen showing a robot and a robot] I've been playing my favourite game called Apex Legends with my team and it's intense! Check out this screenshot of us playing!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Man, Apex Legends looks tough! The graphics are unreal. How does it stack up against other games?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Apex Legends has awesome graphics and super fast-paced gameplay. It definitely stands out among other games.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Hmm, the speed of it definitely makes it fun! Are there any new games that you're looking forward to trying out?
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a video game cover of a video game] Yeah, I'm always excited to try new games. Thinking of trying RPGs like that or MOBAs. Sounds cool!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: RPGs and MOBAs can be awesome to experience an engaging story or have epic multiplayer fights. Let me know how you like them!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Sure thing, John! Can't wait to try out some new genres. I'll definitely let you know my thoughts once I give them a try.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Love hearing about it. Let's chat soon!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Sure John, I'll keep you updated on all the new games. Talk to you soon! Bye for now!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Let me know how it goes. Stay safe. Talk to you soon. Bye!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: [Image: a photo of a dog and a cat sitting on a dog bed] Hey John! Long time no chat - I adopted a pup from a shelter in Stamford last week and my days have been so much happier with him in the fam. I named it Ned. Any progress on your gaming goals?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Hey James! Congrats on getting a pup! They really do make days brighter. I haven't made much progress with gaming lately, life's been busy with work and stuff but it's always nice to remember how happy gaming makes me. It's a good way to forget the stresses of life.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Thanks, John! Gaming really does help forget about the stresses of life. It's like heading into another world! Have you played any interesting games lately?
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: [Image: a photo of a city at night with a view of the city] I'm playing this new RPG that has a really cool story and world. It's kinda like getting transported to a futuristic dystopia.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Sounds great! Will I like it? I'm always up for trying new games.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: [Image: a photo of a computer screen with a game on it] You'll love it! It has a fun story and an awesome world. Plus, it has some tough gameplay. However, the game is a little laggy and sometimes produces errors. Here is one of them that I came across yesterday.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: The game must still be raw. I'd rather wait until the bugs are completely fixed, and then I'll try it out.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Even with minor bugs, the game still looks great. The graphics are awesome and the gameplay is super immersive. I'm sure you should try it out now. I can send you a link.
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Okay, you convinced me. Well, I'll wait for the link then, thanks!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Cool, I'll send it to you. Let me know what you think after you check it out!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Cool, John! I'll check it out and let you know what I think. I'm excited to give it a try.
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Thanks, James! Excited to hear your thoughts. Have a great time!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: Cheers! Will do. Enjoy the gaming! Bye!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Bye for now!
events.speaker: John

events.content: James: See ya! Take care!
events.speaker: James

events.content: John: Take care!
events.speaker: John
